name: autonomous-software-testing
description: An evidence-driven testing agent: profiles a repository, decides which testing actually applies, scores risk, chooses tools, executes, collects evidence, and reports honestly on what was and was not tested.

risk_profile.title: Default risk weighting profile
risk_profile.description: Which weighting the risk engine uses when the orchestrator does not choose one explicitly.

state_dir.title: Testing state directory
state_dir.description: Where sessions, decisions, evidence and reports are persisted. Defaults to <plugin>/state.

allow_external_writes.title: Allow external writes without re-asking each time
allow_external_writes.description: Leave OFF unless you understand the consequence. When OFF (recommended), every GitHub/Jira/document write asks for explicit authorisation in the session. This setting never enables the prohibited-by-default actions.
